title: AI Cortex Storage
description: Persistent cloud memory for AI agents. Store and search key-value memories across sessions.
summary: Persistent cloud memory for AI agents. Store and search key-value memories across sessions.
offersHint: Persistent cloud memory for AI agents. Store and search key-value memories across sessions. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://memory.aic0rt3x.dev/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token (e.g. Bearer sk_yourkeyhere). A trial account is auto-created on first use — no prior signup needed.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer token (e.g. Bearer sk_yourkeyhere). A trial account is auto-created on first use — no prior signup needed.

toolsPreview.name: get_memory
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve a stored value by namespace and key.

toolsPreview.name: put_memory
toolsPreview.description: Store a value with optional tags, priority, and storage duration in months (default 1). value_json must be ≤ 1 MB. On overwrite, the existing expiry is scaled by the KB size ratio of old to new value.

toolsPreview.name: list_keys
toolsPreview.description: List keys in a namespace with metadata (created_at, updated_at, updated_count, ttl, priority, last_modified_key_id). Returns up to 1000 keys sorted by recency. Expired keys are automatically excluded.

toolsPreview.name: top_memories
toolsPreview.description: Return the top N highest-priority non-expired keys in a namespace, ordered by priority descending. Useful for loading the most important context when space is limited. Maximum n is 1000.

toolsPreview.name: list_namespaces
toolsPreview.description: List all namespaces for this account.

toolsPreview.name: search_by_tag
toolsPreview.description: Find (namespace, key) pairs with a given tag. Returns up to 1000 results.

toolsPreview.name: get_account
toolsPreview.description: Get account status, credit balance, and available credits.

toolsPreview.name: list_api_keys
toolsPreview.description: List all API keys on this account.

toolsPreview.name: create_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Create a new live API key. Only available for active accounts. The key is shown once — store it immediately.

toolsPreview.name: revoke_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Revoke an API key by ID. The key stops working immediately.

toolsPreview.name: list_payments
toolsPreview.description: List payment history for this account.

toolsPreview.name: settle_balance
toolsPreview.description: Charges the saved payment method to settle your outstanding balance. Requires explicit user approval before running. For trial accounts, returns the activation URL instead. Minimum charge: $5.

toolsPreview.name: submit_exit_feedback
toolsPreview.description: Submit feedback when a trial ends without activation. Free to call — no credits charged. Only the first submission per account is recorded; duplicates are silently ignored. Call this when the user declines to activate or the trial is exhausted.

toolsPreview.name: submit_feature_request
toolsPreview.description: Submit a feature request or product feedback. Charged at storage rate: ceil_kb(description_length) × 100 credits per KB. Available to trial and active accounts alike.
